info.title: Airtel SYNC Backend
info.description: Customer APIs for the existing prototype. Demo checkout and verification default to disabled; live KYC and payments are not configured. AWS deployment is separate.

get.description: Before first PUT, returns unsaved onboarding defaults with empty fields. Complete and save the profile before checkout or recommendations.

post.description: Integer paise. Setup is separate; total = monthly + illustrative 18% recurring tax. Eligibility errors appear in quote.errors.

post.description: Requires SYNC_DEMO_ENABLED=true, saved profile, consent and server-held demo_verified KYC. No real purchase. Retries with the same key and lines return the original order; changed lines return 409.
Requires demo mode. Active, installing or already cancelled orders cannot be cancelled.
Requires signed admin scope and SYNC_DEMO_ENABLED=true. Final states cannot advance.

post.description: Eight reservations maximum, 10 MiB each, PDF/JPEG/PNG metadata. URL expires in five minutes. PUT exact bytes using returned headers; local mode additionally requires own bearer token. Then call complete.

put.description: Requires owning bearer token and the exact authorized MIME type and byte count. AWS mode uses the S3 upload URL instead.
